Leadership, Compassion, Empowerment, Professionalism and Excellence - that is what we believe in.

Know If You're Ready

The system tracks which subjects you are good at and which ones you are failing, giving you a clear score that shows if you are actually ready for the board exam.

You don't have to wait days for a teacher to grade your work; you get your score and see your mistakes the second you finish a practice exam.

About Us

The company has been involved in various review programs for more than sixteen (16) years and has maintained its quality and innovative review programs with certified top caliber National and Resident Specialist involved in providing comprehensive Lectures and Integrated Test series to improve the reviewees passing rate.

It is located all over the country with several branches in Cagayan de Oro City, Butuan, Surigao, Malaybalay, Valencia, Pagadian, Ozamiz, Tacloban, Baguio, Cebu, and Dumaguete City. Its main branch is located at 3/F GJL Bldg. Julio Pacana St. Licoan, Cagayan de Oro City.

We administer review program for Philippine Nursing Licensure Examination (PNLE), Commission on Graduates of Foreign Nursing Schools (CGFNS), National Council Licensure Examination (NCLEX), Health Authority-Abu Dhabi (HAAD), Board Licensure Exam for Professional Teachers (BLEPT), Board Licensure Exam for Psychometrician and Psychology (BLEPP), International English Language Testing Service (IELTS), Pharmacy, Midwifery and Career Civil Service Examination.
